about: The scenarios that every SDK passes in its own tests. A test that passes a scenario writes its id to the file SAYSO_SCENARIO_REPORT names. scripts/sdk-parity compares the reports of the Go, TypeScript, and Rust suites with this list. na names an SDK ("rust") or an SDK on one system ("rust/windows") where the scenario does not apply, and why.

scenarios.title: The messages of the wire corpus decode and encode again, unknown names are kept, and the names match names.json
The socket and data folder rules give the paths of paths.json
hello is allowed, and the features come from the host
A denied app gets not_approved
An unanswered question makes hello wait, and the approval callback runs once
A capability that the app did not ask for is named in the capability error
A fifth waiting connection of one app is busy
The SDK refuses mic and system sources that the host says it lacks
A host with no features list gets each request and answers for itself

na.go/windows: the fake old host listens on a Unix socket
na.typescript/windows: the fake old host listens on a Unix socket
na.rust/windows: the fake old host listens on a Unix socket

scenarios.title: The host says its version and the protocol, and the SDK says its own version
list_models gives every model, or the models of one role
A download that the user allows downloads the model; an unknown model is unknown_model
A download that the user declines is declined
A job of a file has its events and one end
A job with diarization gives the speakers
cancel_job ends a running job with one job_failed
A job whose model is not on disk is model_not_downloaded
A live session of the client source in Sayso mode has partials and a final text
A live session of the microphone of the host gives segments of the source mic
With the microphone and the system audio, the echo rule drops the microphone segments that repeat the system audio
The silence limit gives one silence_limit event
record_to writes a WAV file for each source
A second live session while one runs is refused
enhance runs a style or a prompt, and an empty text is bad_request
subscribe gets dictation_done, and never an incognito one
A host that closes ends the open job, and the connection ends with host_closing
A killed host is connection_lost, with one end for each job
Sayso mode reconnects after the host came back
Auto starts in Local mode and follows Sayso once no work runs
Auto: a host killed while a job runs ends the job once, and Auto goes back to Local mode
Auto goes back to Local mode when Sayso quits
Sayso mode without Sayso is host_not_running
Sayso mode with start tries the launchers until one starts Sayso
Local mode lists the catalog, downloads a model, and transcribes a file
Local mode runs a live session of the client source
Local mode cuts a file where the voice stops for long, and transcribes each part
An engine that does not start gives an error with what it wrote on stderr

na.rust/windows: the test starts the engine with a shell script

scenarios.title: Finding the engine takes the last version folder and the best build for the processor
The cleanup catalog has the two pinned models, and renders the prompt of each
A cleanup model download checks the hash and writes ready.json last
The cleanup runtime says hello, loads, counts, completes, and unloads
A long text goes to the cleanup runtime in parts and comes back as one text
On macOS, Local mode with the Go capture or sayso-audio offers no system audio: no audio.system, and a session of the source system is unsupported

na.rust: the crate captures in its own process with no helper, and captures the system audio on macOS
na.go/linux: the Go capture records the system audio on Linux
na.go/windows: the Go capture records the system audio on Windows
na.typescript/linux: sayso-audio captures the system audio on Linux
na.typescript/windows: sayso-audio captures the system audio on Windows
